description: This file defines locale-specific information and date parsing/formatting functions for Belize English (en-BZ). It customizes date and time formats, day and month names, regex patterns, and time zone info specific to the locale.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets a Date object to the start of the day (midnight).

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of a Date object to the current system time.
